items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Johnny Laporte was on drums and uh the old Monk Johnny left and Monk played uh played drums did Monk ever tell you about the the old man used to put the bill in his drum where he'd have to tear the drum down at the end of the night to get tip money out of it

ctx.x: well I think that Frank Frober was one of the finest then uh I'm trying to think Pruitt not Pruitt what was his name played with us at the Ritz and uh Johnny Laporte was on drums and uh the old Monk Johnny left and Monk played uh played drums did Monk ever tell you about the the old man used to put the bill in his drum where he'd have to tear the drum down at the end of the night to get tip money out of it no this old man used to come up every now and then he'd put a bill in the bass drum you know roll it up and…
